01-7.stem: A thief is noticed by a policeman from a distance of 200 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. The thief and the policeman run at the rate of 10 km/hr and 11 km/hr respectively. How far will the policeman have run when he catches the thief?
01-7.reason: 'At what distance will the policeman catch the thief' was ambiguous: 2.2 km from the policeman's start (D, the key) or 2 km run by the thief (B, also an option). Reworded to ask the policeman's distance; 2 km stays as the trap. Key D stands.
